title: SVMap 1.2 sim/movers.json
description: Each mover's own time per leg and easing per key (movers.md). The validator also checks what a schema cannot: every actor is a mover of the map, listed once.

movers.description: One entry per mover, in any order; a mover is listed at most once.

actor.description: The id of an Engine.Mover (or subclass) actor in sim/gameplay.json; ids match ignoring ASCII case.

keys.description: keys[n] for key n (Engine.Mover KeyPos[8]); a key the list does not reach keeps the mover's own timing.

key.description: An empty object keeps the mover's own timing at this key.

time.description: Seconds of the leg between key n - 1 and key n, run either way (Engine.Mover.InterpolateTo's shortest leg to an hour). Key 0 takes none.

smooth.description: Whether the mover eases in and out at this key; without it the mover's MoverGlideType decides.

firstKey.description: Key 0 has no leg before it, so it takes no time.
